notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 27 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer2127cont), the weekly issues from 2 July to 31 December 1927. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1926-1929, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1927. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; about 200 of the 318 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner (same surname at the owner's address) that name is cut too. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the running heads (redate.py), checked to be weekly and unbroken.

coverage.remaining: Vol. 26 parts 1 and 2 and vol. 27 parts 1 and 2 read; the other 30 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 28 part 1 (January-June 1928) next. In this volume: 421 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 597 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 522 rows were not placed: 207 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 201 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 113 printed street numbers with no EAS row today and 1 ambiguous.
coverage.note: 2,777 numbered entries read, 1,858 San Francisco rows, 1,336 placed on a parcel, 318 picked and read against the page image, 304 published on 284 pages (201 seeded), 14 held back at the image check (same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, uses that contradict the roll, a repeat listing, a roof sign, a condominium unit lot).
